# dsh-miliastra v0.6.0

**安装**：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.0` → 重启 `dsh web`
**Install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.0`, then restart `dsh web`.

[中文](#cn-v0.6.0) | [English](#en-v0.6.0)

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.0">✨ 新增功能</h3>

- **`op=vfx-lua` 新增「图元层」（`SHAPE_KIND="sprite"`）**：**一个形状 = 一个控件**（+ 残影），沿**多段**贝塞尔路径飞、
  可按 `STRETCH` 拉伸、可按切向旋转 —— 控件数从"每层一个池（默认 192）"降到"每层 1 + 残影数"，
  这是**唯一能在真机预算内继续加特效密度**的方向。 @LoktLin
- **三个图元预设**：`ring-arc`（环刃·扩张圆环）／`slash-arc`（刀光·切向拉伸 + 3 层残影）／`crescent-arc`（新月·两段路径）。 @LoktLin
- **`op=vfx-lua` 的 `paths` 支持多段**（点数 `4+3k`，段数 `(n−1)/3`）：图元层一条路径最多三段；
  粒子层保持"正好 4 点"的老契约，报错时指路"用图元预设"。 @LoktLin
- **新增 `miliastra_code op=preflight`**（**只读**）：**一次把"能不能上真机"查完** ——
  `[Lua 语法 · 结构配对 · 全局写 · 图片有图源 · 作用域 · 风格基线]` 逐文件一张表 + `verdict`（"N 项不过 ⇒ 别部署"）。 @LoktLin
- **`miliastra_health op=sha all:true`**：全部活文件**一张表**（`liveSha`/`mirrorSha`/`embeddedSha`/`verdict`）
  + `summary{needSave,needDeploy,consistent}`，并直接点出"该存盘的文件名"（原先一次只比一个文件）。 @LoktLin
- **`miliastra_sim op=bind` 新增 `runForMs`**：起完会话后**逐帧真跑** N 毫秒（固定步长 1/30，上限 60000ms = 1800 帧，
  超出夹紧并如实标）—— 15 秒级的长流程（死亡 / 重生）不用再改玩法数值去凑时长。 @LoktLin
- **`op=play action=step` 新增 `args.frames`**：把"推进几帧"与"跳到几秒"分开；回执恒带 `note` 说明语义。 @LoktLin
- **交接值台账回显到 `miliastra_sim op=bind`**：`containerId` 优先级 **显式 > 台账 > 都不给**（只读台账；
  只有显式 `miliastra_health op=handover action=set` 才写）。 @LoktLin

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.0-bug">🐛 问题修复</h3>

- **`deploy` 的结构校验从不查语法**：新增 **fengari 真解析器**（`luaL_loadbuffer` 真编译、报错带行号）并**接进部署闸门**
  （strict 档直接拒）；回执同时给出 `lintChecks` / `lintSkips` **自述边界** ——
  以前"deploy 成功"很容易被当成"语法正确"（一轮里 3 次语法错就是这么漏到真机前的）。 @LoktLin
- **`output:"data"` 时 `paths` 被静默忽略**（那段处理排在数据早返回之后）：已上移到早返回之前。 @LoktLin
- **帧率探针在真机上停不下来**：停止闸写的是全局变量，真机上不生效 ⇒ 每帧重复上报（实测一局刷出 13 983 行 / 2.8 MB）。
  改为 **local 停止闸 + 兜底条数上限**。 @LoktLin
- **像素画产物从不指定图源**：`imageColor` 改不了"有没有图" ⇒ 真机整屏 `?` 占位符；现在逐块补
  `SetImage(Enum.ImageSource.StaticReference, …)`。 @LoktLin
- **`miliastra_log` 的 `matched` 是"返回条数"而不是"命中总数"**（`limit:1` 恒回 1）：改为**截断前的真总数**，
  并补 `returned` / `truncated` / `matchedNote`。 @LoktLin
- **`op=load` 无视 `summaryOnly`** ⇒ 一次回执 1.0 MB：现在 `summaryOnly:true` 只回摘要（约 9 KB），默认档不变。 @LoktLin
- **`patch add` 给不了 `imageId`**（E1③ 之后"想要一块有色方块"没入口）：`add` 重新支持 `imageId` 并回 `imageIdApplied`。 @LoktLin
- **`handoverFrom` 的顺序与文档不一致**：抽成纯函数钉死 `gil+arg`（台账只在末尾追加 `+ledger`）。 @LoktLin
- **`durationSec` 在异常收尾时是反推的上界**（实测报过 1203 秒、其实早停了）：回执新增 `durationInferred` + `durationNote`。 @LoktLin
- **测试会污染真实数据目录**：`npm test` 会往用户的截图目录塞测试图、并覆盖模拟器「上次配方」——
  现在默认隔离到临时目录（要看图显式 `VFX_TEST_KEEP_SHOTS=1`）。 @LoktLin

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.0-improve">🎨 体验优化</h3>

- **`op=bind` 默认走精简档**：只回 `controlCount`（含峰值）/ `logs` / `handover.missing` / 会话与时长字段 / 脚本摘要，
  全文要 `withMeta:true`（或 `summaryOnly:false`）—— 实测同一份绑定回执 **4986 B → 3579 B**；
  被省掉的长段落用 `omitted[]` + `slimNote` 如实点名。 @LoktLin
- **`deploy` 的 `summaryOnly:true` 去掉 `candidates[]`**（10 条活文件的字节/时间对"这次写没写成功"是噪声），
  判据字段一个不删。 @LoktLin
- **写盘类操作在"当前关卡"有歧义时直接拒绝**（`code:"LEVEL_AMBIGUOUS"` + 列出候选 + 要求显式 `level`）——
  活文件是唯一副本，写错关卡等于覆盖另一张图的同名脚本。 @LoktLin
- **回执里点明日志来源**：`bind` / `play` 带 `logScopeNote`（**这是模拟器日志，随时可读；真机的 `.gia` 要等一局结束，
  局中判画面只能截图**）；`op=status` 的 `.gia` 落盘说明改写为实测口径。 @LoktLin
- **`op=vfx-lua` 的预设清单带 `shapeKind`**：13 个粒子预设 + 3 个图元预设一眼分流；`summaryOnly` 只留 id 与中文名。 @LoktLin
- **`miliastra_code op=clean` 支持 `summaryOnly`**（要删上千张截图时不再逐条列文件名）。 @LoktLin
- **工具 schema 减重**：长描述下沉到文档，棘轮维持在 31.9 KB / 32 KB 以内。 @LoktLin

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.0-chores">⚠️ 其他变更</h3>

- **模拟器与真机对齐**：图片控件没显式指定贴图时，模拟器**与真机一样画 `?`**（不再替它补方块）；
  素材号但模拟器画不出的另画蓝框 `?`（**不代表缺贴图**）。 @LoktLin
- **测试与文档**：套件 **30 → 33**（新增图元层 43 条、真语法检查 22 条、`op=preflight` 14 条断言）；
  新增《反馈与工单汇总》与"日志三通道实时性"实测表。 @LoktLin
- **未验证（如实标）**：图元层的**真机渲染**（`SetLocalRotation` 正负、`Enum.ImageType.Stretch` 缩放、拉伸采样质量）
  尚无真机证据 —— 生成物顶部与回执 `unverified[]` 都写明，并留了 `SPIN_SIGN` / `IMAGE_TYPE` 两个一行开关；
  模拟器只把非正方形图片画成"圆"，**拉伸形状必须真机看**。 @LoktLin

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.5.1...v0.6.0

---

<h3 id="en-v0.6.0">✨ New Features</h3>

- **New sprite layer kind in `op=vfx-lua` (`SHAPE_KIND="sprite"`)**: **one shape = one control** (plus trails), flying along a
  **multi-segment** Bézier path, stretchable via `STRETCH`, rotatable to the path tangent — control count drops from
  "one pool per layer (192 by default)" to "1 per layer + trails", the only way to keep adding effect density within budget. @LoktLin
- **Three sprite presets**: `ring-arc` (expanding ring blade), `slash-arc` (tangent-aligned blade + 3 trails),
  `crescent-arc` (two-segment crescent). @LoktLin
- **Multi-segment `paths` for `op=vfx-lua`** (`4+3k` points, `(n−1)/3` segments): up to three segments for sprite layers;
  particle layers keep the strict 4-point contract and are pointed to sprite presets on error. @LoktLin
- **New read-only `miliastra_code op=preflight`**: answers "can this ship to device?" in one call —
  a per-file table of `[Lua syntax · structure · global writes · image source · scope · style baseline]` plus a verdict. @LoktLin
- **`miliastra_health op=sha all:true`**: every live file in **one table** (`liveSha`/`mirrorSha`/`embeddedSha`/`verdict`)
  with `summary{needSave,needDeploy,consistent}` and the exact list of files that need a save. @LoktLin
- **`miliastra_sim op=bind` gains `runForMs`**: after starting the session it **advances frame by frame** for N milliseconds
  (fixed 1/30 step, capped at 60000 ms = 1800 frames, clamped value reported) — long flows (death/respawn) no longer need
  gameplay values to be hacked down for testing. @LoktLin
- **`op=play action=step` gains `args.frames`**: separates "advance N frames" from "jump the clock by N seconds"; the receipt
  always carries a `note` explaining the semantics. @LoktLin
- **Handover ledger now feeds `miliastra_sim op=bind`**: `containerId` resolves explicit > ledger > absent (ledger is read-only;
  only an explicit `miliastra_health op=handover action=set` writes it). @LoktLin

<h3 id="en-v0.6.0-bug">🐛 Bug Fixes</h3>

- **`deploy`'s structural lint never checked syntax**: added a real **fengari parser** (`luaL_loadbuffer`, errors with line
  numbers) wired into the deploy gate (strict mode rejects), and the receipt now states its own boundary via
  `lintChecks` / `lintSkips` — "deploy succeeded" used to be mistaken for "the syntax is fine". @LoktLin
- **`paths` was silently ignored with `output:"data"`**: the handling now runs before the data early-return. @LoktLin
- **The frame-rate probe could not stop on device**: its stop switch wrote a global, which does not persist on device, so it
  reported every frame (13,983 lines / 2.8 MB in one run). Now a **local** switch plus a hard report cap. @LoktLin
- **Pixel-art output never set an image source**: `imageColor` cannot make an image exist, so the device rendered a screen of
  `?` placeholders; every block now calls `SetImage(Enum.ImageSource.StaticReference, …)`. @LoktLin
- **`miliastra_log`'s `matched` reported the window size, not the hit count**: it is now the true pre-truncation total, with
  `returned` / `truncated` / `matchedNote` alongside. @LoktLin
- **`op=load` ignored `summaryOnly`** and returned a 1.0 MB receipt: `summaryOnly:true` now returns a ~9 KB summary while the
  default stays unchanged. @LoktLin
- **`patch add` could not set `imageId`**: supported again, reporting `imageIdApplied`. @LoktLin
- **`handoverFrom` order disagreed with the docs**: extracted into a pure function pinned to `gil+arg` (ledger appended last). @LoktLin
- **`durationSec` is an inferred upper bound after an abnormal stop** (1203 s was reported for a run that had ended long
  before): the receipt now carries `durationInferred` + `durationNote`. @LoktLin
- **Tests polluted the real data directory**: `npm test` wrote test screenshots into the user's folder and overwrote the
  simulator's "last recipe"; tests are now isolated to a temp directory (`VFX_TEST_KEEP_SHOTS=1` opts out). @LoktLin

<h3 id="en-v0.6.0-improve">🎨 Improvements</h3>

- **`op=bind` defaults to a slim receipt**: only `controlCount` (with peak) / `logs` / `handover.missing` / session and timing
  fields / a script digest; ask for everything with `withMeta:true` (or `summaryOnly:false`). Measured **4986 B → 3579 B**,
  with the omitted long sections named in `omitted[]` + `slimNote`. @LoktLin
- **`deploy` with `summaryOnly:true` drops `candidates[]`** (the byte/mtime list of ten live files is noise for "did this write
  succeed"), while every decision field is kept. @LoktLin
- **Write operations now refuse an ambiguous "current level"** (`code:"LEVEL_AMBIGUOUS"`, candidates listed, explicit `level`
  required) — the live file is the only copy, and a wrong level overwrites another map's script of the same name. @LoktLin
- **Receipts state where logs come from**: `bind` / `play` carry `logScopeNote` (simulator logs are readable at any time, the
  device's `.gia` only lands after a run, so mid-run visual checks must use screenshots). @LoktLin
- **The `op=vfx-lua` preset list now carries `shapeKind`** (13 particle presets + 3 sprite presets), and `summaryOnly` keeps
  ids and Chinese names only. @LoktLin
- **`miliastra_code op=clean` supports `summaryOnly`** (deleting thousands of screenshots no longer lists every file name). @LoktLin
- **Tool schema diet**: long descriptions moved into docs, keeping the 31.9 KB / 32 KB ratchet satisfied. @LoktLin

<h3 id="en-v0.6.0-chores">⚠️ Chores</h3>

- **Simulator aligned with the device**: image controls without an explicit texture now render `?` in the simulator too
  (no more substitute square); known asset ids the simulator cannot draw get a blue `?` (which does **not** mean a missing texture). @LoktLin
- **Tests and docs**: suites **30 → 33** (43 new sprite assertions, 22 syntax-check assertions, 14 `op=preflight` assertions),
  plus a consolidated feedback/work-order document and a measured "log channels: what is real-time" table. @LoktLin
- **Not verified (stated plainly)**: device rendering of sprite layers (rotation sign, `Enum.ImageType.Stretch` scaling,
  stretched sampling quality) still has no device evidence — the artifact header and `unverified[]` say so, with one-line
  `SPIN_SIGN` / `IMAGE_TYPE` switches; the simulator draws non-square images as circles, so **stretching must be checked on device**. @LoktLin

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.5.1...v0.6.0
